title: Akedah letter grid: two crossing diagonals meet at the ש — “The Name”
summary: Same Akedah letter grid and “hashem — The Name” diagram, now with two red ellipses crossing in an X over the circled ש: one from ם down to a ה in the divine name, the other from מ down to the opposite ה.

letters.meaning: letter at the centre where the two diagonals cross

pictures.description: A block of black Hebrew letters (Genesis 22:15-16 in rows) with one row boxed in green; two red ellipses cross in an X over the blue ש in the boxed row, joining the blue ם and מ above to the ה letters of the divine name below.

Right-hand diagram in blue, black, red and orange: the title “hashem”, letters ם and מ, a green box holding ש, and the four letters י ה ו ה underlined in red and orange, with two blue arrows pointing at the first and last letters and the caption “The Name”.

uncertain: The slide does not spell out what the crossing diagonals form; they appear to read ה-ש-ם (hashem) and מ-ש-ה
Grid contents were not transcribed cell by cell
